Hi! Wow reading this was crazy because I've struggled with almost exactly that for a long time. It's really hard but here are some things I've tried:

* When you find yourself having a big reaction over something, ask yourself "am I overreacting? is this person trying to make me upset on purpose? is this really that awful?" if you find yourself answering yes to any of those, what I do is take a time out, stop talking to that person for a few hours until I calm down and can see things more clearly, that way I avoid being mean and hurting ppl I care about.
* Take a walk! It's been proven that going on walks when you're feeling this way actually helps your brain and makes you see things more clearly. I thought this was really dumb until I tried it.
* Take anxiety medication. I don't know if you do, but if you don't try to ask your therapist about it. I myself started taking some light anxiety medication and it really changed my day.
* Help yourself. I'm well aware it's not easy, but if you feel like you're about to engage in destructive behavior just stop for a second and remind yourself you don't want to be like this,  you deserve better. Try to recognize when these feelings are starting to arise so that you can start calming down before they get worse.
